message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4 && grep -n "compressBlockHC\|LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate\|LZ4F_compressBlockHC" lib/lz4frame.c | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The vulnerability is a use-of-uninitialized-value in `LZ4HC_compress_generic_noDictCtx` triggered via `LZ4F_compressBlockHC`. The fuzzer uses `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate` which was newly added. Let me look at the relevant code in lz4frame.c and lz4hc.c.
